title: Qrow: every feature in 3 minutes (demo_final.mp4)
note: Fully automated demo (Playwright on the live site, the owner's public address in a read-only view: nothing is signed, every action stops at its review step). The AI tab is left out: hidden in the recording browser, never clicked, never named. Voice: edge-tts en-US-AndrewNeural, rate +5%. `seconds` is each scene's budget; a scene lasts max(budget, voice + 0.7 s).

scenes.caption: This is Qrow: payments and more, signed with quantum-safe keys.
The Hub puts every feature in one place, with your live balance, prices and open prediction markets.
New here? The Faucet gets you free test QOR and fUSD from QoreChain's official faucet.
Swap trades on the chain's own exchange. Type twenty-five QOR, and Qrow quotes what you'll receive before you sign.
Trade opens perpetual positions on live prices. Pick ETH, go long with fifty fUSD at ten times leverage, and review it before signing.
Predictions let you back YES or NO on crypto and QoreChain questions. The prices show the odds.
Sending is simple. Paste the address, enter fifteen fUSD and choose how it's released. The confirm screen checks for lookalike addresses before you approve in QoreX.
To get paid, request forty fUSD with a note, then share the link or the QR code.
The NFT Shop mints Qrow Genesis art, drawn entirely on chain.
Or create your own: upload your artwork, name it, and choose how many copies to mint.
The NFT Market lists pieces at the seller's price, with the floor and community collections.
Portfolio shows your balances, your NFTs and any payments waiting in escrow.
History lists every transaction from your wallet, read from the chain, each with a hash you can verify.
Staking delegates QOR to a validator, and an optional lock adds a bonus.
Launch creates a testnet memecoin, with anti-scam rules like a fixed supply built in.
Market News brings live prices and the latest crypto headlines.
Verify reads any hash straight from the testnet. Here's my own swap: confirmed, who signed, and the ML-DSA-87 signature the chain checked.
And Admin and Analytics shows live Qrow numbers from the chain.
Thanks for watching. Try Qrow free on testnet.
